title: December 2026 Movies to Watch: Key Release Dates in the US and India
seoTitle: December 2026 Movies: US and India Release Dates
excerpt: A practical December 2026 movie guide covering Avengers: Doomsday, Dune: Part Three, King, Violent Night 2 and Jumanji: Open World—with US and India dates clearly labelled.
content:
December 2026 has several major theatrical releases, led by Avengers: Doomsday, Dune: Part Three and Shah Rukh Khan's King. Their release dates are not identical in every market: Avengers: Doomsday is scheduled for December 17 in India and December 18 in the United States, while King is scheduled for December 24 in India. This guide separates confirmed market-specific dates from dates that still need local confirmation.

Last checked: November 25, 2026. Film schedules can change, and a US release date should not be treated as a worldwide date. Before travelling or booking, check the distributor announcement and the listing at your local cinema.

“Listed” means the date appears in a current release calendar or ticketing listing, but readers should still verify availability with their local distributor or cinema. This is a selected guide to notable titles, not a complete worldwide release database.

The Two Big Hollywood Releases on December 18

Avengers: Doomsday

Marvel Studios has scheduled Avengers: Doomsday for December 18, 2026 in the United States. Indian audiences are scheduled to see it one day earlier, on December 17, in English, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu, according to the India release announcement reported in October. The film is directed by Anthony and Joe Russo and features Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans and Chris Hemsworth among its large ensemble cast.

The story brings heroes from different corners of the Marvel universe into a confrontation with a major threat. If you want to catch up before the film, revisiting the earlier Avengers films and the relevant Fantastic Four and X-Men stories may add context, but check Marvel's official film information for the latest details.

Official information: Marvel Studios — Avengers: Doomsday.

Dune: Part Three

Dune: Part Three, directed by Denis Villeneuve, is scheduled for December 18, 2026 in the United States. Current Indian release listings also show December 18, but local schedules can change. The film continues the screen adaptation of Frank Herbert's Dune saga, with Timothée Chalamet and Zendaya returning among the principal cast.

The December 18 pairing of Doomsday and Dune has been nicknamed “Dunesday” by fans and entertainment coverage. Treat it as a playful label for the scheduling coincidence—not an official event or a studio-created release campaign.

For release updates, check Warner Bros. and your local cinema listings.

Indian Cinema: King Arrives on December 24

Shah Rukh Khan's King, directed by Siddharth Anand, is scheduled to release in Indian cinemas on December 24, 2026. The cast includes Shah Rukh Khan, Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone and Abhishek Bachchan. The makers' countdown post and current Indian listings identify December 24 as the release date.

Do not confuse a domestic release listing with a confirmed date for every international territory. Overseas dates and local language or certification details should be checked with the distributor and the cinema in that country.

Check the current listing at BookMyShow — King and updates from Yash Raj Films where applicable.

More December Releases to Keep on Your Radar

Violent Night 2 — December 4

The sequel to the action-comedy is scheduled for a wide US theatrical release on December 4. David Harbour returns, with Tommy Wirkola directing. The India date was not confirmed in the release sources checked for this update, so check local listings rather than assuming it opens on the US date.

The Angry Birds Movie 3 — December 23 in the US

The animated sequel is listed for a December 23 US release. Indian release calendars currently list January 1, 2027, so it should not be described as a confirmed December India release. Families should check local language versions and showtimes closer to the date.

Jumanji: Open World — December 25

The next Jumanji film is scheduled for December 25 in US release calendars, and Indian ticketing listings also show December 25. Confirm the local showtime and language version before making plans.

Werwulf — December 25 in the US

Robert Eggers' period horror film is listed for a December 25 US release. Its release outside the US may be staggered; no India date is confirmed in the sources used here.

What About Ticket Prices?

There is no single December 2026 ticket price. In India, the amount depends on the city, cinema chain, auditorium, format, seat category, showtime and booking fees. A premium-format opening-night ticket can cost much more than a standard 2D weekday show, so one unusually high price should never be presented as the normal price for all viewers.

For an accurate quote, search the exact film and date in your local cinema or ticket-booking app. Compare the final checkout amount—not just the displayed base fare—and check whether convenience fees or taxes are added. Prices and showtimes are live inventory and may change.

How to Plan Your December Movie Calendar

  • Check the country first: US, India and other territories can have different opening days.
  • Confirm the format: IMAX, 4DX, Dolby and standard screenings can have different prices and availability.
  • Check language options: Indian cinemas may list English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu and other dubbed versions separately.
  • Use the cinema's current listing: Release calendars are useful for planning, but the local cinema page is the best place to confirm actual showtimes and seats.
  • Recheck close to release: Distributors can move dates or adjust the number of screens.

Frequently Asked Questions

When does Avengers: Doomsday release in India?

It is scheduled for December 17, 2026 in India, one day before the December 18 US date. Confirm the show listing with your local cinema.

When does Dune: Part Three release?

The US date is December 18, 2026. Current Indian release listings also show December 18, but readers should confirm the local distributor and cinema schedule.

When does Shah Rukh Khan's King release?

King is scheduled for December 24, 2026 in India. International release dates should be checked territory by territory.

Are Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three releasing on the same day?

Both are scheduled for December 18 in the US. In India, Doomsday is scheduled for December 17, while Dune is listed for December 18.

Is ₹4,000 the normal price for an Avengers ticket?

No. Ticket prices vary widely by venue, format, seat and showtime. Check the final price for the exact cinema and session you plan to attend.

Is this a complete worldwide release calendar?

No. It is a selected guide to notable releases, with US and India dates shown where current sources support them. Worldwide release dates are territory-specific and should be confirmed with local distributors.
